Illustrative business scenario: Transfer an employee between departments and cost centers
Expected result: Effective-dated change and downstream ownership reflected
Evidence to retain: Before and after values with approvals

Illustrative business scenario: Process a sample payroll calculation for eligible workers

Expected result: Approved totals and control counts agree end to end
Control or dependency: Interface technical evidence and finance controls
Evidence to retain: Control totals and signed interface result

Illustrative business scenario: Submit an annual leave request and manager approval
Expected result: Entitlement and balance reflect policy and approval

Illustrative business scenario: Validate time-entry approval for affected worker group
Expected result: Approved time entries progress to downstream processing
Evidence to retain: Approved sample time records and reconciliation

Illustrative business scenario: Move an applicant from review to offer stage
Expected result: Correct permitted users see the stage and action
Control or dependency: Applicant data access and recruiting workflow

Control or dependency: Offer approval and personal data minimization

Illustrative business scenario: Launch a talent review with approved population criteria
Expected result: Correct eligible population and ratings appear

Illustrative business scenario: Record succession readiness with approved access
Expected result: Authorized reviewers can update and retrieve decisions

Expected result: Correct population receives assignment and notifications
